content.text:
Here are good **free online auto repair estimate** options, depending on what you need:

## For mechanical repairs / maintenance
- **RepairPal Estimator** — free repair-cost ranges by ZIP code, vehicle, and repair type; also shows certified shops and 30-day guaranteed prices at participating locations. ([repairpal.com](https://repairpal.com/estimator/repair-services?utm_source=openai))  
- **YourMechanic Instant Estimates** — free instant quotes for common services like brakes, alternator, starter, oil leaks, diagnostics, etc.; includes parts/labor breakdown and mobile mechanic booking. ([yourmechanic.com](https://www.yourmechanic.com/estimates/?utm_source=openai))  

## For collision / body damage
- **Instant Estimator** — free online auto body estimator for cosmetic/body/paint damage; can connect you with local body shops and let you submit photos. ([instantestimator.com](https://www.instantestimator.com/?utm_source=openai))  
- **Otto Fix It** — free AI estimate from uploaded damage photos, then nearby shops can send quotes. ([ottofixit.com](https://www.ottofixit.com/free-car-repair-estimate?utm_source=openai))  
- **VTCCO** — free AI collision/body damage estimate from uploaded photos; mainly positioned for accident support and preliminary estimates. ([vtcco.com](https://vtcco.com/?utm_source=openai))  

## Quick tip
Online estimates are usually **preliminary**. Final price can change after a shop inspects the car, especially if there’s hidden damage, rust, electrical issues, or parts availability problems.

If you tell me your **year/make/model**, **ZIP code**, and the **repair needed** or upload/describe the damage, I can help you estimate a realistic price range.
